recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to white (#FFFFFF).
2. Add a yellow circle badge in the top-right corner with the number '34'.
3. Create six confusion-matrix panels in a 2-column grid on the left two-thirds of the slide:
   - Column 1 (top to bottom): Threshold=0.0, Threshold=0.1, Threshold=0.3, Threshold=0.4
   - Column 2 (top to bottom): Threshold=0.6, Threshold=0.7, [empty], [text box]
   Each panel: light red header (#FFB3B3) with 'Threshold=X.X' in white bold; sub-header 'Predicted as'; column headers P and N; row header 'Actual' rotated vertically on the left; 2x2 cell grid with red borders (#CC0000); values as transcribed.
   Add TPR and FPR calculation text to the right of each matrix exactly as transcribed.
4. Add the text 'Best (FPR)' to the right of the Threshold=0.7 panel.
5. Add a centered text box with blue border in the bottom-middle containing: 'ROC Curve for Same Model -different thresholds'.
6. On the right third of the slide, create a large panel with light blue background (#E6F0FF). Draw X-axis labeled 'FPR' and Y-axis labeled 'TPR' (vertical). Add faint grid lines. Plot six red circular points and place white label boxes near them with threshold values: '0.3', '0.1', '0.0' across the top; '0.7', '0.4', '0.6' in the middle/lower area.
7. In the bottom-right corner, add two formula boxes: 'TPR = TP / (TP + FN)' and 'FPR = FP / (FP + TN)'.
8. Below the formulas, add a small confusion-matrix legend with headers 'Predicted as', 'P', 'N'; row labels 'Actual', 'P', 'N'; cells: TP (light red background), FN, FP, TN (light green background).
9. Use black sans-serif text for all body content; ensure all numbers and formulas match the verbatim transcription exactly.
